feedback.population: Pani NHANES 2001-2004 n=3270, adults age>=25, no self-reported diabetes, FPG<126 mg/dL, HbA1c available. Complex survey design and weights. FOS context is different and is not pooled. NHANES overlaps Liu1999-2008. Monte Carlo reconstruction: assumed age support 25-95, published unweighted age-band count proportions used as approximate mixture probabilities, truncated geometric age tail >=70, and independent female probability 0.5; unweighted calculations are not the complex survey estimator; 6000 fictional rows, not source IPD.

measurement.description: Generated age years, BMI kg/m^2, glucose mg/dL and HbA1c percent are passed unchanged to fixed operators. Published units are normalized in admitted evidence; identity here does not verify assay, plasma/serum or survey-estimator equivalence.

checks.reason: Uses an unweighted assumed NHANES age-band mixture, independent assumed sex composition, transported Lifelines covariate dispersion and shared linear conditional rule. Original survey weights/PSU/strata are unavailable. Only the 50-54 mean anchors the Pani level; the other seven means diagnose linear age and transport assumptions, including the likely older-age plateau discrepancy. The >=70 reconstruction extends through95.
